name: Open Canvas
summary: The video as an open design file: the speaker cut out over their own footage rectangle on a black drafting grid, real screen captures in light-blue selection frames, a cursor that drags things into place, pointers that land on the spoken word, word-by-word captions with one brush-script word, and a bare-face ask to close. Voice only, hard cuts.
bestFor: tool and repo walkthroughs with real pages to show
"this now does that" news in 30 to 60 seconds
